# dokploy_project (Resource)

Manages a Dokploy project. Projects are top-level containers that organize environments and services.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a Dokploy project

resource "dokploy_project" "example" {
  name        = "my-project"
  description = "Example project for applications"
}

output "project_id" {
  value = dokploy_project.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the project.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the project.

## Import

Projects can be imported using their ID:

```shell
terraform import dokploy_project.example abc123-project-id
```

Or using import blocks (Terraform 1.5+):

```hcl
import {
  to = dokploy_project.example
  id = "abc123-project-id"
}
```

### Finding Project IDs

Use the `dokploy_projects` data source to discover project IDs:

```hcl
data "dokploy_projects" "all" {}

output "project_ids" {
  value = { for p in data.dokploy_projects.all.projects : p.name => p.id }
}
```
